subject: Scope confirmation: sample QA queries, success matrix, and delivery windows
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@datafoundry.com>, Priya Rao <priya@datafoundry.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Scope confirmation: sample QA queries, success matrix, and delivery windows

Hi Liam / Priya —

Thanks again for the call earlier. Quick written recap and a clear set of asks so we can kick off the 6-week trial smoothly. Please read and confirm next steps below.

Summary of what we need from DataFoundry for the evaluation:

- Representative query set ("sample QA queries"): 10k anonymized user queries spanning search, chat, and form-fill flows. CSV preferred with columns: "query_id, user_intent, query_text, session_id (optional), label_expected_output".
- Raw API logs: last 30 days (or as much as available) of request/response logs for the same features. Redact PII or mark fields that are PII; see minimal schema in attached sample-schema.jsonl.
- Failure cases & edge examples: 200–500 labeled items where current system returns incorrect or partial answers (helps regression checks).

Success criteria we'll use in the trial (high level):

- Intent accuracy: target >= 88% on classification slices we discussed (search vs. chat).
- Generation quality: 80%+ pass rate on human-eval rubrics for 3 critical flows (support summaries, code snippets, knowledge retrieval).
- Latency: 95th percentile end-to-end token latency <= 800 ms on standard baseline.
- Cost delta: per-token inference cost improvement target >= 20% compared to your baseline (we'll measure after we run a small pilot).

Owners and timelines:

- DataFoundry (Liam / Priya): deliver sample queries + logs by EOD Tuesday, 2026-10-05 (we can accept partial batches earlier).
- Redwood AE (Jordan): coordinate scope and acceptance; verify sample representativeness.
- Redwood CS (Marissa): prepare eval harness and run initial pilot within 3 business days of ingest.
- Infra/Engineering (Ben): prepare sandbox model variants and performance baseline.

Upload options and attachments:

- Preferred: upload to s3://datafoundry-trial/sample-queries/ (we will provide IAM role or presigned URLs once you confirm).
- Alternate: secure file transfer link (we can issue temporarily)

I've attached a short checklist (trial-eval-checklist.xlsx) and a minimal sample schema (sample-schema.jsonl) to make the mapping immediate.

Please reply with: (1) confirmation of the Oct 5 target or proposed alternate date, (2) preferred upload method, and (3) any PII/contract/NDAs we should be aware of up front.

Thanks — looking forward to getting the data over.

—Jordan
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0192
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@datafoundry.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Rao <priya@datafoundry.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 23:40:12 +0100
Subject: Re: Scope confirmation: sample QA queries, success matrix, and delivery windows

Jordan — thanks for the clear recap. Confirming a few items and asking clarifying Qs so our data team can package everything correctly.

Confirmed: we can provide the 10k sample queries and failure-case set. We can also export logs but need to confirm scope: do you require full headers + response bodies, or is a redacted version acceptable? We typically strip IPs and full email/text PII on exports; let us know if token-level data is required for your eval.

Proposed delivery: initial 2k sample queries + 3 days of logs by 2026-10-01 for your early testing; full 10k + 30-day logs by 2026-10-05.

Upload: S3 transfer works for us. We'll need an IAM role or presigned URLs from Redwood to push directly to the bucket. We can also provide a secure tar.gz if that is simpler.

Questions:
- Any constraints on schema (we saw your sample-schema.jsonl but want to confirm the label format for expected_output)?
- Will you accept anonymized session_id values (hashed) in place of raw IDs?

I'll loop in Priya for procurement/NDAs (cc'd). If those are standard, we can route via our legal team quickly.

Thanks — Liam

Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 09:18:30 -0700
Subject: Re: Scope confirmation: sample QA queries, success matrix, and delivery windows

Hi Liam / Priya — Marissa from Customer Success here. Adding a few practical notes to make the ingest smooth.

1) Upload / access options (pick one):
   - We can create a short-lived IAM role with write access to s3://datafoundry-trial/sample-queries/; if you want this route, please provide the AWS account ID you will use to push objects and the principal email.
   - If preferred, provide presigned PUT URLs for each file (we will accept a manifest with file names and sizes).

2) File format and naming convention we prefer (helps automation):
   - sample_queries_YYYYMMDD.csv (UTF-8, comma-separated)
   - logs_raw_YYYYMMDD.jsonl (one event per line, JSONL)
   - failure_cases.csv

3) Minimal schema checks (aligned with Jordan's sample-schema.jsonl):
   - query_id (string), query_text (string), user_intent (one of: search, chat, form), expected_output (string), confidence_label (optional).

4) PII guidance: hashed session_id is fine. Strip or redact direct identifiers (emails, phone numbers). If masking is not feasible, flag fields as PII in the manifest and we can handle safe transfer.

5) Timeline commitment: if you confirm by COB Thu 2026-10-01 we will reserve a CS sandbox run for Tue 2026-10-06 and provide initial pilot results by 2026-10-09.

6) Attachments and tools: we'll upload an ingestion manifest template to the shared Drive link in the thread after you confirm the upload method.

If you want, Ben can join a brief 20-min tech sync to confirm schema and mapping before you export — he is cc'd.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

Thanks Jordan / Marissa — we can meet that schedule. Quick update from our side:

- Initial batch: sample_queries_20261004.csv (2k rows) + logs_raw_20261002-20261004.jsonl will be uploaded via presigned PUT URLs.
- Full delivery: sample_queries_full_20261005.tar.gz (10k rows) + logs_20260905-20261004.tar.gz on 2026-10-05.
- Files (names and checksums) will be listed in manifest_manifest_20261004.csv.

S3 presigned URLs (temporary): https://datafoundry-transfer.s3.amazonaws.com/presigned-upload-EXAMPLE
(We will generate and send final presigned links once you confirm acceptance and the number of files to expect.)

PII: session_id will be hashed; we will redact emails and replace with [REDACTED_EMAIL]. Full IP logs will be stripped — we can provide a separate IP-mapping file under NDA if needed.

Procurement note: our legal team expects the standard Redwood DPA + short SOW addendum for a 6-week trial. I have uploaded the SOW draft to: https://drive.datafoundry.com/s/abc123-trial-sow (private link; access will be granted to jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com).

Let us know if you want a 20-min schema check on Friday 2026-10-02 morning (PST) — Liam and I can join.

—Priya
